product.title: Enciclopedia vieții. Minute, luni, milenii- cât durează o viață pe pământ
product.description: O privire de ansamblu asupra tuturor formelorde viață de pe Pământ, organizată în funcțiede durata de viață a fiecărei specii. Cronologii a peste 230 de specii, de la alge caretrăiesc mai puțin de o zi la bacterii care au supraviețuitpentru mii ndash; sau chiar milioane ndash; de ani. Casete colorate în care sunt înscrise duratele de viațăfurnizează clar informația esențială pentru fiecare specie. Prezentarea speciilor scoate în evidență grupuri de animale și de plante de un interes deosebit pentru tinerii cititori. Cu multe hărți și diagrame dinamice, această prezentareanalizează subiecte fundamentale pentru educație,cum ar fi evoluția, habitatele, lanțurile trofice și extincția. O secțiune examinează în detaliu speranța de viațăa oamenilor ndash; cum a crescut în timp și pentruce diferă atât de mult de la o țară la alta. Un mijloc educativ convingător, care face trimiterila știință, biologie, istorie și geografie.

Explore the vast tapestry of life on Earth with this comprehensive **Encyclopedia of Life**. Perfect for students and science enthusiasts, it provides a fascinating look at biological timescalesâfrom mere minutes to millions of years.

## A Comprehensive Look at Global Biodiversity

This encyclopedia chronicles the life cycles of over 230 species, structuring the information based on their incredible longevity. Journey through time with examples ranging from algae that live for less than a day, all the way up to bacteria surviving for thousands or even millions of years.

The engaging format makes complex biological data easy to digest:

*   **Visual Clarity:** Color-coded inserts clearly display the life spans for every species featured.
*   **Targeted Learning:** The presentation highlights specific groups of plants and animals that are particularly interesting for young readers, making it a compelling study aid.
*   **Key Scientific Concepts:** Beyond simple timelines, the book utilizes numerous maps and dynamic diagrams to analyze fundamental educational subjects, including evolution, habitats, trophic chains, and extinction events.

## Deep Dive into Life Science Topics

The content goes far beyond listing species durations, offering deep academic value across multiple disciplines:

### Evolution and Ecology
Discover how life adapts through detailed sections analyzing ecosystems. The material provides a robust introduction to **biology**, covering concepts like the food chain and natural habitats in an accessible manner.

### Human Longevity and History
A dedicated section focuses on human lifespanâexamining how average life expectancy has increased over time and why these figures vary significantly between different countries, making it relevant for social studies and geography students alike.

This volume serves as a convincing educational tool, bridging the gap between **science, biology, history, and geography**. It is designed to spark curiosity and provide foundational knowledge about the planet's living world.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What makes this book unique?**
The distinguishing feature of this encyclopedia is its focus on organizing life forms not just by habitat or classification, but primarily by their lifespanâfrom minutes to millions of years.

**Is this suitable for students?**
Yes. The presentation is designed with young readers in mind, using clear diagrams and organized sections to cover complex academic topics like evolution and ecology.

**Does it only cover animal life?**
No. It provides a holistic view, covering various forms of life including algae (plants) and bacteria, alongside animals.
